info.title: heidy_api
info.description: Student academic organizer API (v1 targets USP). Thin Phoenix controllers over rich domain contexts. All times are ISO 8601 UTC; ids are UUID v4. Errors use a single envelope. See docs/architecture.md and docs/api.md.

202.description: accepted (does not reveal whether the email exists)

delete.summary: Delete the account and all owned data

post.summary: Store or replace the USP credential (PIN-encrypted)

put.summary: Rotate the PIN (re-wraps the data key)

post.summary: Verify the credential against USP live

score: must be less than or equal to max_score

Password.description: 8-72 chars, at least one letter and one digit.

Pin.description: 4-12 digits. Never stored; encrypts the USP credential.

usp_password.description: USP Senha Unica; encrypted at rest, never returned.

EnrollmentInput.description: Provide title, or discipline_id (which fills title/credits), or both.

needed_on_remaining.description: null if unreachable or already decided.
